To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the presented nanorobotic AF/SEM/FIB systems enable the processing, characterization and manipulation of nanomaterial.

the nanorobotic SEM/FIB system is able to handle nanowires, that the nanorobotics AFM system enables the analysis of nanowire surfaces and that a gas injection system can be used for the deposition and structuring of nanomaterial on the nanorobot.
we developed a nanorobotsystem containing an AFM, SEM and FIB that can be operated in an integrated manner.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a nanorobots system for the handling, processing and characterization of nanometer-sized objects.
the development of nanorobotic systems for the manipulation and characterization of nanostructures and nano-objects, and for their hybrid processing.
the investigation of the interaction between nanorobotic handling and nanostructuring.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the system presented in this paper is a very powerful tool to analyze nanostructured surfaces as it combines AFM with SEM and FIB.
the nanorobotic AFMS/SEM/FIB-system is a very useful tool for the processing and analysis of nanostructured materials and nanoobjects.
this nanorobotic AFMS/SEM/FIB setup is a very powerful tool for processing, manipulation, and characterization of nanoscale objects.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the nanorobotic AFMS/SEM/FIB systems have been successfully used for processing, manipulation, and analysis of nanoobjects and nanostructured materials.
we have developed a nanorobtic system that is suitable for the processing of nanostructured materials and nanoobjects.
the presented system allows for a variety of applications in the field of nanotechnology.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a hybrid AFM/SEM/ FIB nanorobotic manipulation and processing system is a powerful tool that can be used to investigate the properties of nanostructured materials.
a nanohandling system can be combined with other nanoscale tools to create an enabling technology platform for hybrid processing, manipulation, and characterization of nanoscale objects.
the nanorobotic AFMS system enables the manipulation, processing and characterization of nanoscale objects in a single system.
